resources.string: This spike supports Android 16 or newer.
Enter the values shown by RoamADB Gateway. Registration codes are used once and are not saved.
Start RoamADB Gateway in tailnet mode, then enter the PC Tailscale IPv4 address and the values it shows. Keep Tailscale connected during registration.
Technical spike: the existing-Tailscale path is implemented. Direct public access, built-in secure networking, and physical-device end-to-end validation are still pending.
Open Developer options → Wireless debugging and enter the connect port shown under this device’s IP address. This is not the temporary pairing port.
Notification permission is required so Android can show when remote debugging is active.
Choose how the phone reaches the home PC Gateway.
Use an already connected Tailscale app. RoamADB handles only Gateway authentication and the ADB relay. Other VPN engines need a future Gateway adapter.
Connect directly through a public address and router forwarding. Configure and secure the network separately.
A future one-app mode that would include the private network function.
This build does not yet include the built-in secure-network engine. Select another method.
